_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_as_of: 2026-07-13 · Session 113 (SkyTeleo) — the HVAC mis-mint thread → a new auditor rule + blank-discipline cleanup, all merged (before wave 4)
_status: Sam caught one course — HVAC M10FR (LA Trade DIESLTK 122C) minted 'HVAC' but really Diesel, because the title word 'HVAC' had overridden the field. That one catch became a new auditor rule (subject_discipline_outlier) that finds the whole class: a course whose assigned discipline is a small minority of what its LOCAL subject code usually means, AND the TOP code or lexicon agrees on the same fix. It even catches single-college courses the older rules skip. 41 of the clearest corrections fired live; ~302 more are now behind a new 'Subject-code outlier' filter in the Triage dropdown, each with a suggested discipline. We also cleaned up the display (blank courses no longer show a fake common subject) and pre-seeded ~77 blank-discipline courses from 5 safe subject codes. The ≥2-agree gate earned its keep — it dropped codes whose titles disagreed with the code (DANCFOLK is wellness, not dance). Next: CCR wave 4, with the new chip + shrinking blank set feeding in.
